## Role in the Rating Process

The [International Monetary Fund](../institutions/international-monetary-fund.qmd) supplies core macroeconomic and fiscal data for the minimal rating process. Its *World Economic Outlook* is the primary data source for [Growth](../parameters/growth.qmd) (C1), [Inflation Differential](../parameters/inflation-differential.qmd) (C2), [Fiscal Capacity](../parameters/fiscal-capacity.qmd) (C3), and [Refinancing Need](../parameters/refinancing-need.qmd) (R1) parameters. The *Fiscal Monitor* provides additional coverage of primary balances (C3). Article IV reports offer a cross-check for gross financing needs (R1). Additionally, loans issued under IMF programs count as off-market financing (R1-A*), reducing the market-exposed portion of sovereign debt.
